comment: Orientation policy document for the S10+ (beyond2lte). ONE authoritative source shared by Quick Settings, Settings, nuxelctl and nuxel-orientationd. There are SEVEN named modes exactly (the owner phrase 'six modes' is a count mismatch: four fixed poses plus three auto policies). Selected policy (mode) is distinct from the current effective orientation (effective_degrees). Nothing here rotates pixels by itself: nuxel-orientationd computes the desired transform and asks the compositor, and reports honestly when the compositor cannot apply it.

mount_matrix.comment: 3x3 row-major map from sensor axes to display-native axes (x=right, y=up, z=out of screen). This is the DEFAULT convention and MUST be calibrated from observed device motion on hardware; until then it is calibration_status=unverified.

gravity_reference.comment: Unit gravity vector (display-native) for each discrete orientation. 0=portrait, 90/180/270 clockwise physical poses. Unverified until observed on the actual handset.

sensor_hub.requires_patch_loader: the Broadcom LHD sensor-hub patch loader is not shipped; raw_data remains 0,0,0 until the hub MCU is initialized
sensor_hub.comment: nuxel-orientationd drives these real kernel nodes before an Auto probe: ESW:READY wakes the BBD/SSP bridge and the accelerometer bit is OR-ed into enable. raw_data must then become non-zero; no synthetic sample is ever used. The vendor Android lhd runtime (with /system/bin/linker64) is required to patch the BCM47752 MCU; when absent, Auto remains truthfully blocked.

compositor.comment_transform_map: Canonical clockwise pose -> wlr-randr transform. PWNAGE-54000 live measurement: Phoc HEADLESS-1 captures a 720x1520 buffer and grim exposes the transformed 1520x720 logical desktop. The historical 90->270 / 270->90 mapping is retained. Touch uses the inverse coordinate mapping through libinput calibration in the Nuxel libinput shim; nuxel-wl-fb does not rotate pixels a second time.
compositor.presenter_compensation: none: phoc screencopy returns the transformed logical frame in the portrait 720x1520 binding; nuxel-wl-fb scales it directly to 1440x3040

touch.mechanism: libinput calibration matrix driven by the verified compositor transform; Phoc receives already-mapped touch coordinates; nuxel-wl-fb never rotates touch

compositor.input_matrix_comment: libinput calibration matrix selected from the compositor transform that was actually read back. 270 means the portrait touch frame must be mapped 270 degrees clockwise into the 1520x720 logical desktop; the matrix is applied exactly once by libnuxel-libinput-path.so inside Phoc.
